metadata.description: Unique name for your Azure Container App
Shared secret key matching $TUNNEL_SECRET in mysql_tunnel.php
Full HTTPS URL to wake OVH (e.g. https://yourdomain.com/mysql_tunnel.php?key=YOUR_URL_SECRET_KEY)

containers.name: mysql-relay
command: npm install ws && node -e "const net=require('net'),{WebSocketServer}=require('ws'),S=process.env.API_SECRET,W=process.env.WAKE_URL;let ovh=null,waking=false;const c=new Map(),q=[];function go(t){const id=Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);c.set(id,t);ovh.send(JSON.stringify({action:'OPEN_DB',sessionId:id}));}function wake(){if(waking||!W)return;waking=true;fetch(W).catch(()=>{}).finally(()=>setTimeout(()=>{waking=false},3000));}new WebSocketServer({port:8080}).on('connection',(w,r)=>{if(r.headers['x-api-key']!==S)return w.close();const id=r.headers['x-session-id'];if(!id){ovh=w;w.on('close',()=>{if(ovh===w)ovh=null});while(q.length>0){const t=q.shift();if(!t.destroyed)go(t);}return;}const t=c.get(id);if(!t)return w.close();w.on('message',d=>t.write(d));t.on('data',d=>w.send(d));w.on('close',()=>t.destroy());t.on('close',()=>{c.delete(id);w.close()});});net.createServer(t=>{if(ovh&&ovh.readyState===1)return go(t);q.push(t);wake();const to=setTimeout(()=>{const i=q.indexOf(t);if(i!==-1){q.splice(i,1);t.destroy();}},6000);t.on('close',()=>clearTimeout(to));}).listen(3306,'0.0.0.0');"
